Hi Elena / Stephen,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call yesterday — excited to get Atlas Health into the onboarding flow. To keep momentum, can we lock a 90-minute customer kickoff in the next week? Proposed windows (all PT):

- Tue, Jul 6 — 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed, Jul 7 — 11:00–12:30 (preferred on our side)

Please confirm which slot works for your team and who from Atlas should be on the invite (we typically ask for: executive sponsor, product owner, engineering lead, and IT/security contact). If none of the times work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Attached is a lightweight draft agenda (launchpad-agenda-v0.1.docx) and an implementation checklist we’ll walk through. I’ve also included a short calendar poll if you prefer to vote instead of proposing times: https://doodle.com/rdw-atlas-launchpad

If this looks good I’ll send a calendar hold and a final agenda.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
